services.name: Colombian Salsa Night
services.desc: Feel the rhythm. Step into a vibrant Latin night right here in Lynchburg. Enjoy 1-hour beginner-friendly dance class (7-8 PM) + 1-hour dance social (8-9 PM). Come move, connect, and experience the energy of a true Latin vibe.💃 Instructor: Diana

services.name: Yoga at Casa Nueva
services.desc: Step into the airy, light-filled space of Casa Nueva for a rejuvenating yoga class that energizes your body and calms your mind. Framed by soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and Casa Nueva’s warm, earth-toned palette, you’ll move through a dynamic sequence of postures guided by breath and intention.This all-levels class emphasizes fluid movement and mindful transitions, enhanced by the openness and natural light that define the space.Finish your flow and head over to Palmera House for 20% off any food or drink item. Open to all-sign up now or pay on arrival! Join our newsletter to be the first to learn about upcoming events & premium offers. A collection of thoughtfully designed spaces

services.name: Rumba Tropical NIGHT
services.desc: Get ready for an evening of movement, music, and tropical energy! Rumba Tropical is a fun, beginner-friendly Latin dance experience featuring a mix of salsa, merengue, bachata, reggaeton, and other popular Latin rhythms. The evening begins with easy-to-follow instruction from Diana Ibarra, followed by an open dance social where you can practice your new moves, meet new people, and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere.
